title: Forcing the other valleys to ≥ 281 excludes leftover L=84 at m≥3
statement: On a Juggler CycleMin of length 84 at residual floor 261, CycleMin geometry (cycleMin_not_odd_even, cycleMin_even_ge_sq, even_iter_lt_succ_pow) forces every non-start valley to sit at ≥ 281, and that height-split excludes every m≥3 under a proved finance constant.
counterexamples: Charging both others at 281 still misses Lean inv-sum (S≈0.012126); 6/5 first kills at n2≥369
A later OE landing at 263 exists (v=1687, T(v)=69290) but requires that high valley, so the triple is 261/263/1687 and dies; it is not the adversary
notes: The 281 first-circuit landing is a corollary of even_iter_lt_succ_pow, not a new defect law. Height-split constant 1 first kills at 281 but is not a proved form. Not a leftover-itinerary census, not a floor raise, and not a halt theorem.
tested_range: L=84, n=261, first-circuit k=2..24, later landings from 281, k=1 OE window through v=20000; constants 1 and 6/5 and Lean inv-sum
